caseName: Johnson v. United States District Court for the Southern District of Ohio
caseNameFull: Johnson v. United States District Court for the Southern District of Ohio and Johnson v. Marshall

opinions.text: Appeal from C. A. 6th Cir. dismissed for want of jurisdiction. Treating the papers whereon the appeal was taken as a petition for writ of certiorari, certiorari denied. Reported below: 703 F. 2d 563 (second case).
